display_audio_tensor: display a PyTorch audio tensor as an interactive audio player in a Jupyter notebook
display_audio_stereo: display stereo audio samples with shape [C, T] using the notebook audio display utility
display_audio_batch: display a batch of audio samples with shape [B, C, T] as separate audio players
review_display_audio: review the display_audio function to understand how it handles 2D and 3D tensor shapes
refactor_display_audio: refactor the display_audio function to support additional tensor formats or audio normalization
